Name: Robin's Less Ugly House
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][i]Robin's Less Ugly House[/i][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with an unusually long description. [/size]

[size=3]Note to self; [/size][b][size=3]never[/size][/b][size=3] do the most annoying part of something when your eyes are half asleep, lest you want to redo it all over again after a thousand red error lines. :,)[/size]
[size=3]I feel like I drained everything I had doing this, arghhh... Anyway, [/size]

[size=3]Maybe at this point you can already have a sense of my design choices, you might've already noticed a pattern throughout all my interior edits, or you might be thinking to yourself.. "Hmm.. This looks familiar."[/size]
[size=3]Well you're not wrong lol. Listen alright, in my dictionary there is only like 4-5 wallpapers and 2-3 floors that are acceptable.[/size]

[size=5][b]I've already seen that Wallpaper/Floor/Design with your other mods!
[/b][/size]
[size=3]Think of it as Robins carpentry choice. Not that I'm saying that she built all the houses (Since Evelyn and George definitely has been in Pelican town longer than her), but I'd like to think she's built a few.
Maybe one of the recent ones even?
So before you call me out on having too much of a similar design choice, blame Robin. :p

On another note, ever noticed how their kitchen is the size of a closet? There's a famous saying how a Family grows closer when they sit and dine together, but with the size of their kitchen it's literally no surprise on how that isn't possible. No wonder they seem kind of distant to each other pfft.

Sure Robin and Demetrius sometimes dances together, but why are they like 5 ft across the bed facing the opposite direction? Somethings fishy I tell ya.. not to mention Demetrius' relationship with Sebastian. [b]What relationship?[/b] Exactly.
Do my boy Sebby some justice! >:0

[i][u][color=#ea9999][size=5]NEW!! 1.0.4[/size][/color]

[/u][/i][list]
[*][size=3]Added an [u][b][color=#a4c2f4]Optional[/color][/b][/u] version - It's more compatible with other mods + recolor friendly. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM![/url][/size]
[/list][/size]
[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][size=3][b]AFTER[/b][/size][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted!
[/size][size=1][b](As a side note; you may or may not have noticed I added one more extra thing in the kitchen that isn't in the initial screenshot, I lacked the energy to retake the pictures lol.)[/b][/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size]
[size=3] 
[/size]
[color=#ff0000][size=5][b][i]Very Important, Read me![/i][/b][/size][/color]

[size=5]What this mod [/size][i][u][color=#ff0000][size=5][b]DOESN'T[/b][/size][/color][/u] [/i][size=5]do:[/size]
[b]
[size=4]1. Makes Demetrius a better person

[/size][/b][size=3]Why are you confused?[/size]

[size=4][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/size][size=3] [/size]
[size=3]Like my other mods, I made this with the [u][b]VANILLA[/b][/u] cutscenes in mind. [s]So in theory, it should work fine [b]without[/b] any mods that expands on the households story, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside their home.[/s][/size][s]

[size=3][b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.[/b][/size][/s][u][b]
[/b][/u]
[size=3]As of Update 1.0.1, use the [b][u][color=#a4c2f4]Optional [/color][/u][/b]version if you encounter any issues.
[/size]
[b][size=4]3. Gives Demetrius and Sebastian a better father-and-son relationship.

[/size][/b][size=3]Maybe you can tell, but I really don't like Demetrius >:|[/size]

[/size]
